name: @yottameta/yotta-triage
description: Yuanjian — a zero-dependency static malware triage engine for AI agents: MD5/SHA1/SHA256 hashes, magic-type detection, Shannon entropy, printable strings (ASCII/UTF-16LE) with URL/domain/IP/email/command/path/base64 classification, and PE/ELF header parsing (architecture, timestamp, sections, packed/RWX indicators). Outputs a triage report plus an IOC list (hash/URL/domain/IP/email) for downstream intel consumption. Pure Python 3.8+ standard library, fully offline and read-only; no deobfuscation, unpacking, or execution. Triggers when the user provides a suspicious file/sample or a folder of samples and needs static triage, hashing, entropy, string extraction, or PE/ELF inspection. Boundaries: static features only; never executes or modifies samples; authorized / own-asset / educational use only.
